pages.text: $(bold)Entity Highlight$()$(br2)Press $(bold)Y$() to highlight battlefield entities with colored outlines.$(br2)$(bold)Color Coding:$()$(br)• $(2)Green$(): Friendly entities$(br)• $(4)Red$(): Hostile entities$(br)• $(6)Yellow$(): Neutral entities$(br2)$(bold)Priority:$() Vanilla Glowing > Fire Control > Y-key highlight

$(bold)Aircraft Highlight$()$(br2)Aircraft also display status-based colors:$(br2)• Color changes based on team affiliation$(br)• Helps identify friend from foe in chaotic battles$(br)• Controlled via $(o)isCurrentlyGlowing()$() and $(o)getTeamColor()$()$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Use highlights to track priority targets!
